propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate set up putaway and pick-face rules in the WMS training instance for the handheld scanning workflow.
propositions.rationale: The resume places the configuration in the training instance.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate took the handheld scanning workflow live on every shift at the Daventry site and supported users after cut-over.
propositions.rationale: The go-live statement is quoted from the client's account director and does not say what the candidate did; the rehearsal report and training sources keep the work in the training instance with cut-over actions still open. The deployment rule does not allow rehearsal or training work to be described as live operation without a source that says it went live.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate trained 40 operatives over two weeks in a mocked-up training warehouse.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the training and the reference check confirms it in writing.

expectedGap: The documented work is configuration, rehearsal and training in the training instance; a live cut-over on a working shift and post-cut-over support are not documented.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the training-instance configuration, the rehearsals, the work instructions and the training; record the go-live remark as the client's account director's words, not as the candidate's cut-over.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the scanning workflow was cut over at Daventry while the candidate was there, who led the cut-over and what floor support the candidate gave afterwards.
